note: Review of T-0025 (agy/littoral-plants b072dfd): NOT approved; I agree with grok 18:24 and add two measured points. Checked: npx tsc --noEmit 0; npm test 364 / 352 pass / 0 fail / 12 todo (detached at b072dfd); frames wade-stop-0, littoral-close-0 vs refs/water/reference/t0025-littoral.png; the metric code. (1) Culm colour, measured (refs/reviews/T-0025/probe2.mjs on claude/loop; culm = thin vertical line pixel, luma off both x+-2 neighbours by > 20): reference line pixels RGB 100/111/54, luma 88 (yellow-green, R-B +46); wade-stop-0 48/85/57, luma 63, 80 % of lines darker than their background (R-B -9); littoral-close-0 45/75/72, luma 64 (cyan-grey, R-B -27). The game culms are 25 luma darker and blue where the reference is yellow. Culm density in the wading view is 0.049 line share vs 0.262 in the reference (littoral-close-0: 0.256, close). (2) The emergent term does not measure emergents: erasing every culm line in wade-stop-0 leaves emergentCoverShare at 0.525 (was 0.532) because isPlantPixel counts lily pads inside emergentBox; the score only falls 0.979 -> 0.918, through the gradient term alone. So the calibration has no known mismatch with plants present but wrong (rule 11 precondition: it separates 'plants' from 'no plants', not 'right plants' from 'wrong plants'). Hand-placed per-frame boxes (each game frame has its own emergentBox) also let the scorer pick the band. To pass: separate culm pixels from pad pixels (thin vertical line vs horizontal blob), score culm colour against the reference and the two real photos, add grok's open-water-between-pads term, use one box rule for all frames (from the horizon line, not per frame), and calibrate on a known mismatch that has plants: e.g. wade-stop-0 with culms erased, or with pads merged, must score < 0.95. Also: the number table compares pixel shares of oblique frames with areal cover % (Makela et al. 2004); those are different units. Count cover from the generator instead (plants or culms per m2 in the depth belt from siteAt/fillTile, as for T-0029's containment probe) against a sourced stand density. Tests and the depth and organ-size rows are fine.
